note: All 55 trophies are single-player; there are no online trophies. Names, descriptions and grades follow the published trophy list (GamesRadar+ / PowerPyx, cross-checked on GameMapa, KeenGamer and GamesFuze, November 2026). Five hidden trophies still have unconfirmed unlock methods and are marked as such rather than guessed at.
sources: GamesRadar+ — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement list (gamesradar.com)
GameMapa — All 55 GTA 6 Trophies: Full List, Gamerscore and Platinum Roadmap (gamemapa.com)
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap – All 55 Trophies (keengamer.com)
GamesFuze — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies & Achievements (gamesfuze.com)
GTAScoop — GTA 6 Trophies & Achievements: Full List of 55 and Platinum (gtascoop.com)

trophies.description: Unlock every other trophy.
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are yours. Nothing about it needs multiplayer or DLC, and no trophy is locked behind difficulty — there is only one difficulty setting in the game. PowerPyx rates the whole road about 4 out of 10 and roughly 200 hours in a single playthrough, with the 100% completion checklist doing most of the heavy lifting.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.description: Attain 100% Completion.
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the set, and the last one most players earn. After the story ends, Progress > Stats gains a 100% Completion entry — that checklist is the trophy. It asks for every robbery, every underwater discovery, every shooting range, every drone race and the Bret questline, but it is kinder than it looks: only 70 of the 80 Challenges are needed, most side quests are not required, and collectibles count only in part. Work through the checklist in the order the game lists it and tick each row off in this guide as you go.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.description: Complete the final mission.
trophies.guide: Story trophy — it unlocks automatically when you finish the final story mission. It cannot be missed, and there is no mission replay, so keep a separate save at the start and end of every chapter if you like a safety net (10 slots covers that; the game gives you 15 manual slots plus one autosave).
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.description: Complete 250 Stunts.
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts scattered across Leonida: jumps, under-bridge flights, Knife Flights and base jumps. You do not need all of them — a quarter more than the trophy asks for exists, so skip the ones that fight you. Stunt jumps show up on the map once you drive near them, and the 100% checklist tracks a larger stunt total, so this one usually pops on the way to A Long Road.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold in all 42 challenges across the 12 shooting ranges. Each range has several weapon challenges with their own par times and accuracy targets, and the 100% checklist needs the ranges too, so this is not extra work on top of the platinum — it is the same work. Take the challenges one range at a time, use the weapon the challenge hands you, and come back with better handling upgrades if a par time keeps beating you.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob 5 of the 8 bank vaults and get away clean. A bank robbery instantly puts you at a 4-star wanted level, which is also how Hot Together usually pops by itself. Plan the escape before the heist: the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is a reliable getaway because cops struggle to follow along the tracks and the helicopter loses sight of you. The trophy unlocks once you leave the red heat zone.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish eight Strangers & Freaks questlines — the purple and black-with-pink icons that appear as you explore. The 100% checklist does not ask for these, so they are usually what is left after the story and the checklist, together with any stray trophies that did not pop on their own. Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone each have their own trophy too, so those five strands count toward this one as well.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets.
trophies.guide: Complete 3 of the 18 collectible card sets. Cards are tucked into shops, houses and odd corners all over Leonida, and the 100% checklist only needs part of the collection, so you can stop at three finished sets. Pick the sets whose cards cluster in places you already visit — Vice City shops and the coastal towns are the densest — and use the in-game collection menu to see which cards of a set you still lack.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.description: WAiNK It at 100 locations.
trophies.guide: Scan 100 spots with the WAiNK app: landmarks, curiosities and sculptures. Open the app and point it at anything that looks like a landmark and the scan prompt appears. Make it a habit from the start of the game — scan every new vehicle you drive too, because Whip It Good and the 100% checklist both count WAiNK scans, and a steady habit beats a 100-spot mop-up at the end.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.description: Complete 50 Challenges.
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges. Challenges are the small feats the game tracks in the background — driving feats, combat feats, exploration feats — and the 100% checklist needs 70 of them, so this trophy pops on the road to A Long Road. Check the Challenges tab in the Progress menu to see which ones are close to done and finish the easy ones first.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Discover 100 vehicles.
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — a WAiNK scan of a new model is enough, you do not have to steal or keep it. The 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base vehicle models, so scan everything you climb into from the first hour. Traffic varies by district, so cruise Vice City, the port and the rural highways to cover the model spread faster.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Clear the fog from the entire Leonida map.
trophies.guide: Clear the fog from the entire Leonida map by driving, flying or sailing through every region. It is pure exploration — no mission gates it — so it pairs naturally with the stunt hunt, the WAiNK scans and the collectible sweeps. Watch the map's fog edge in the pause menu and mop up the corners last: the islands off the coast and the far north of Kelly County are the spots most players leave grey.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 Meditation Spots — and this is the one trophy you can miss. Early in Chapter 1, Lucia mentions meditation in the kitchen at Jason's house one morning and heads out to the balcony: follow her, accept the prompt and she shows you how it works. The meditation counter in the Progress menu goes up by 1, yet the balcony is not marked as a Meditation Spot like the others, and PowerPyx has not confirmed whether the trophy needs it. You cannot do it again after Chapter 1, so just do it. The other 17 spots are marked and can be visited any time.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile.
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile — robberies, thefts, assaults, getaways, anything that moves the profile's meters. You will rack these up without trying across a full playthrough; the profile screen shows your running total. If it is the last one standing, string together low-heat crimes like shoplifting and car theft in a quiet district rather than stacking wanted levels.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types at least once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt. One try each is all it takes — you do not have to win or finish. Most of these unlock in the first chapters, and the 100% checklist asks for more of several of them, so this trophy is usually one of the first bronzes you earn.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at all 14 locations.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. Each location has its own course through rings and around obstacles; learn the racing line on a practice run, then go for the win — the AI racers follow fixed lines, so cutting a corner the course allows is the fastest way past them. The 100% checklist needs the drone races too.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.description: Win 20 different races.
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 on offer. Street races, off-road races and circuit races all count, and each race only counts once, so you need variety rather than repeats. Keep a car tuned for street circuits and a truck for off-road, and take the races that appear near wherever you are already working.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing contest.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing contest. His questline starts in Chapter 1 — look for his icon near the water and work through his fishing jobs until the contest unlocks. Match the lure to the fish the contest asks for, keep the line tension in the green zone, and reel steadily instead of yanking; the contest is won on total weight, so a few medium fish beat one big fight that snaps the line.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.description: Beat any one of the 4 video games.
trophies.guide: Beat any one of the 4 video games — three of them are on the TV at home, so you can do this between missions without travelling. Pick the game that suits you: the platformer is the quickest to learn, the arcade shooter rewards patience. One completed game is enough; you do not need high scores.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Max out Strength for Jason and Lucia at the same time.
trophies.guide: Max out Strength for Jason and Lucia at the same time. Go to the gym together: while one character works out, the other trains automatically, so progress doubles and you do not have to grind the same routine twice. Strength rises from weights and from melee combat, so a few gym sessions between story missions keep it climbing without a dedicated grind.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's 5 quests — Lucia only, from Chapter 3. Andy's strand is one of the Strangers & Freaks questlines, so it counts toward that silver trophy too. His missions revolve around helping him get clean; keep an eye out for his icon after Chapter 3 opens and work through the strand before the finale so it does not get left behind in the cleanup phase.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Clear 7 shipwrecks for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Clear 7 shipwrecks for Kenton, from Chapter 1. Kenton's strand sends you diving on wrecks around the coast to recover his treasure sets — the 100% checklist wants 5 of his 7 sets, so this trophy and the checklist overlap. Bring a boat with a dive ladder, watch your oxygen, and mark each wreck on the map as you clear it so you do not revisit the same one twice.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's 5 quests at the Thrillbilly Mudclub, from Chapter 2. Billy's strand is pure Leonida mud culture — mud races, stunts and favors around the club. It counts toward Strangers & Freaks, and the club itself is a good hub for stunt and race progress while you are there.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Deliver all 16 cars on Randy's Wish List.
trophies.guide: Deliver all 16 cars on Randy's Wish List, from Chapter 3. Randy texts you the models he wants; find them in traffic or parked around Leonida, steal them in good condition and deliver them to his drop-off. Damaged cars still count but pay less, so drive carefully on the delivery run. The wish list rotates as you deliver, so keep his messages in mind whenever you spot a rare model.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete Tyrone's final mission.
trophies.guide: Destroy the labs and finish Tyrone's last quest — Jason only, from Chapter 3. Tyrone's strand targets the labs cooking the product that floods Leonida; the finale is a straight assault, so bring armor, a good rifle and a getaway car parked close. It counts toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret — Jason only. Bret's questline is about tracking rare game with the binoculars and the bow; study animals through the binoculars first, because the 100% checklist wants 100 of the 255 animals studied. The exact animal for this trophy is still being confirmed by guide writers, so check Bret's strand in-game and take the hunt it offers — it counts toward Strangers & Freaks either way.
trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.unconfirmed: The exact animal is still being confirmed.

trophies.description: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Escape a 4-star wanted level together with your partner. It often unlocks by itself, because robbing a bank vault instantly gives you a 4-star wanted level — pair it with Maximum Withdrawal. The easiest escape is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County: cops struggle to follow you along the tracks and the helicopter loses sight of you. The trophy unlocks once you leave the red heat zone.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner while staying wanted. The three jewelry stores in the north of Vice City work well — hit them in sequence and do not let the wanted level drop between robberies. The trophy is delayed and pops about half a minute after you leave the third store, so do not panic if it does not appear immediately.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store undetected. You need the Snap Gun from Chapter 3 — it lets you crack the display cases quietly. Go at night, take out the cameras first, move slowly past the guard's patrol line and leave before the alarm window closes. If you are spotted, walk out and try another store; the attempt does not lock you out.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.description: Rob an armored truck and get away.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and get away. Armored trucks run fixed routes through Vice City — ram the rear doors or block the truck, crack it open and grab the cash, then break line of sight before the escort calls it in. The 100% checklist needs the robberies too, so this one doubles as checklist progress.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.description: Rob one illegal operation from each of the 9 gangs.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation from each of the 9 gangs — 39 operations exist, so you have plenty of choice. Gang operations show up as you explore their turf; hit one per gang and the trophy pops. Note that Gunslinger also wants gang members at their illegal operations, so combine the two: use Combat Focus during these robberies to work on both at once.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling.
trophies.guide: Take all 3 key valuables from Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn and lose the police. Case the alley first: the valuables are in the office, the trophy cabinet and the back room. Grab them in one run if you can, then lose the cops outside — a fast car parked at the side door makes the escape trivial.
trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling

trophies.description: Launder $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a cumulative $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists; fences and contacts clean them for a cut. Keep laundering after every big score instead of sitting on dirty money, and the total adds up across the whole playthrough without a dedicated grind.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.description: Spend a total of $100,000 across shops.
trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across any shops. Clothes, weapons, car parts and food all count, and the total is cumulative across the whole game. If it is still short late in the game, the car mod shops are the fastest way to burn money — a full build on one car can clear the remaining gap in a single visit.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.description: Purchase all eight purchasable garage properties.
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages — $160,000 in total. Garages are listed on the in-game property site and marked on the map once you can afford them. They are also useful: each one stores vehicles near the district you work in, so buy them as you earn the money rather than saving the purchase for the end.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles through the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. Open the app, pick a vehicle you own and register it — delivery and rental cars count too. Ten registrations is quick once you have a small fleet; register each new car as you buy it and the trophy pops without a separate session.
trophies.name: On the Spot

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in one use of Combat Focus. Before the fight, buff your focus with food, drinks or a shower at home, bring Adrenaline and use an assault rifle. PowerPyx notes it does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians, so pick on gang members at their illegal operations — which also counts toward Pest Control. Trigger Combat Focus when the group is clustered and sweep the targets in one burst.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Steal an airliner and fly 1 km away from the airport.
trophies.guide: Steal an airliner docked at a VCIA boarding bridge and fly 1 km away. The easiest airliner is docked at terminals E3/E4 at Vice City International. Board it, get it moving and climb — the trophy unlocks once you are 1 km away from the airport. Ignore the runway traffic and go straight for altitude; the wanted level does not matter once you are airborne.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.description: Steal a tank at Mile Zero Air Station.
trophies.guide: Steal a tank at Mile Zero Air Station. The base is guarded, so go in fast and quiet: slip past the perimeter fence on foot, take the nearest tank and drive straight for the gate. The tank itself shrugs off small-arms fire, so the hard part is reaching it — the escape is the easy half.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Have a cocktail with an Ocean Beach view.
trophies.guide: This hidden trophy is still unsolved: its description points at having a cocktail with an Ocean Beach view, but PowerPyx lists its exact trigger as unknown. The working guess is a specific bar seat on Ocean Beach at the right time of day — try the beachfront bars in the evening and order a cocktail at each until one pops it. This guide will not invent a method: the trigger is marked unconfirmed until players verify it.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash out of a car showroom.
trophies.guide: This hidden trophy is still unsolved: its description points at smashing out of a car showroom, but PowerPyx lists its exact trigger as unknown. The working guess is driving a display car straight through the showroom glass — try the big dealerships in Vice City with a fast car and a running start. This guide will not invent a method: the trigger is marked unconfirmed until players verify it.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: The description hints at a second attempt.
trophies.guide: This hidden trophy is still unsolved: its description hints at a second attempt at something, but PowerPyx lists its condition as unknown. The name suggests failing once and trying again — a second run at a challenge or a retry after a failed attempt. This guide will not invent a method: the trigger is marked unconfirmed until players verify it.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.description: The description hints at something strange.
trophies.guide: This hidden trophy is still unsolved: its description hints at something strange out in Leonida, but PowerPyx lists its condition as unknown. The name nods at the series' long-running UFO and conspiracy easter eggs, so the likely trigger is a strange encounter or location off the beaten path. This guide will not invent a method: the trigger is marked unconfirmed until players verify it.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl someone over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: This hidden trophy is still unsolved in its precise form: the description is a melee drive-by that bowls someone over, but PowerPyx lists the exact trigger as still being confirmed. The working method is a drive-by melee swing — bat or similar — from a slow-moving car into a pedestrian. Try it on a quiet street at low speed so the swing connects. Marked unconfirmed until players verify the exact conditions.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Complete Gone Fishing.
trophies.guide: Story trophy — it unlocks automatically when you finish Gone Fishing, Jason's first mission. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.description: Complete Chapter 1.
trophies.guide: Story trophy — it unlocks automatically when you finish Chapter 1. It cannot be missed. Note: the missable meditation moment with Lucia happens during Chapter 1, so do that before you close the chapter out.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.description: Complete Chapter 2.
trophies.guide: Story trophy — it unlocks automatically when you finish Chapter 2. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Tits Ass Drug Money

trophies.description: Complete Chapter 3.
trophies.guide: Story trophy — it unlocks automatically when you finish Chapter 3. It cannot be missed. Andy's strand opens for Lucia and Tyrone's for Jason in this chapter, so pick them up as they appear.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.description: Complete Chapter 4.
trophies.guide: Story trophy — it unlocks automatically when you finish Chapter 4. It cannot be missed. Three of the remaining story trophies are Chapter 4 missions, so the chapter is dense — work through its missions in order and the trophies stack up.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.description: Complete Breakfast Run.
trophies.guide: Story trophy — it unlocks automatically when you complete Breakfast Run, a Chapter 2 story mission. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.description: Complete a Chapter 3 story mission.
trophies.guide: Story trophy — it unlocks automatically when you complete a Chapter 3 story mission tied to the heist planning. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.description: Complete a Chapter 4 story mission.
trophies.guide: Story trophy — it unlocks automatically when you complete a Chapter 4 story mission. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.description: Complete a Chapter 4 story mission.
trophies.guide: Story trophy — it unlocks automatically when you complete a Chapter 4 story mission. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.description: Complete a Chapter 4 story mission.
trophies.guide: Story trophy — it unlocks automatically when you complete a Chapter 4 story mission. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.description: Complete Operation Savage Glory.
trophies.guide: Story trophy — it unlocks automatically when you complete Operation Savage Glory, a Chapter 5 story mission. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
